requirements.title: Clock dilation, three-dimensional fields, signal timing and bound-pair dynamics

Timing-equivalent embeddings share one cohort. An independently generated light cone and a common rate across other physical clock mechanisms are open.

criteria.title: Earliest decodable message in observer time

An unselected scheduled native write with its memory retained increases later pair yield on disjoint seams from 0.003485 to 0.126725 relative to erasure. The service appointment is supplied.

A moving collision-born species clock requires a different encoding.

Independent beat counts exclude equal squared-frequency shifts for these assignments with either fuel reference. A held three-direction dispersion of a collision-born object requires independent momentum and signal-speed readouts.

requirements.purpose: Record what the spherical candidates have already demonstrated at finite size and which ingredients a full spacetime reconstruction still needs.

criteria.requires: A finite patch reads a local hand or periodic reference from physical registers at more than one setting. State how the source, cadence and readout are supplied.

The same patch reads an intact pair again with probability 0.993226 after heralding one locally, compared with 0.338671 for exchange alone. The reference’s prepared-pair theorem applies in this free sector.

criteria.requires: After a local excitation is identified, another local site or patch detects it with its identifying property intact. Specify whether transport is passive or serviced and keep disappearance and quiet outcomes.

The small eigenvalue was about 3 × 10⁻⁵ relative to the largest and the robust signature lost a direction. The ledger keeps OL-A1 owed.

In free flight, stationary patch hands and one mobile load give joint angular-region and depth records on three nested federations. A uniform internal spectral gap forces every balanced within-cell depth contrast to vanish at low kinetic energy. The polarized control resolves depth and disabled exchange changes the angular counts. An independently refinable radial field with shared clock and physical regional transfer is unproved. A separate source-free test uses four calibrated anchors to predict three held echo times and free-pulse centroids. Every held path misses the 5% tolerance for both probes on 20, 80 and 320 cells. The protocol consequently stops before a localized-load intervention. On the free federation the round radial product of the measured angular screen fails at 5% for every assignment of radial positions on both station menus. Two retained direction coins move in free flight, but their reversal count hides which seam can advance it.

criteria.title: Excess gravity predicted from retained patch records
criteria.requires: Specify the cut charge and its fluctuations on physical observer records. Use the gravitational response calibrated on ordinary matter to predict excess orbital and lensing signals on independent galaxies with one source law, geometry and uncertainty model.

Its protected flight cannot select joint word weights through equilibration inside each word sector.

criteria.note: Free persistence is demonstrated locally for a prepared pair of unassigned species. At held exposure 37 the launch patch has adjacent-pair probability 0.98027 at κ = 8 versus 0.20291 at κ = 0. Seeded records gave 4,028 versus 824 detections in 4,096 draws per arm. For that cell-13 launch the home probability stays at least 0.94 through exposure 37. OpenWave reproduced the probabilities and partially validated the historical pin, whose design search compared strengths using persistence. A later law uses the same signed-record comparison for exchange parity and eight incident witnesses on a shielded standard cell. Its magnitude-one energy is exactly 8, reproducing the binary-pair generator. With a one-port preparation calibrated by stationarity, its magnitude-two energy is exactly 32 and the complete seam generator agrees. A direct simulation recorded 104 transitions from lower modes into magnitude two. The 17-offer digital realization also passes the phase-gate tolerance and all 24 material reunion comparisons. The target was known when the comparator and uniform deployment were chosen. Using fair parity instead approaches 4. The portable contact instrument distinguishes κ = 8 from all eight other published strengths and a pair-only rival before release. For adjacent launches on the stated federation class the probability of adjacency anywhere is at least 5/6 at every exposure. The cell-13 home-pair probability is at least 0.96325 through exposure 37. On the 20-cell board, all 600 internal launch seams clear both sampling forecasts. At exposure 37, 24 have home probability below 0.94. At κ = 8 the 630 distinct-load band levels lie below the two-free-load rest reference. At κ = −8 they lie above the free exchange band. A separate source equates an empty primitive collar bank’s differential frequency to the material coefficient and obtains κ = 8. The zero-strength donor gives the same calibration fringe. This equality was chosen with the persistence results known. The historical pair's coupling has no independent selection in the published sweep. The archived clock and vacuum fringes agree at κ = ½ and 8 while the original home-pair probabilities at exposure 37 differ by more than 0.56. A distinct single-load source passes the free home-cell test for every real coupling on all 420 cells, including preparation exhaustion. Its all-time joint home probability is at least 0.999940596800. OpenWave awarded Partial to the historical pair. The single-load registration is prepared for owner review. Its changed state and detector require adjudication and its task-selected confirmation is pending. Full-credit filing is on HOLD.

PATCH-10 tracks gravitational observations sourced by patch records. A separate coin-odd contrast-two memory has fixed-address native gaps of 32 or 33. Every one of the nine two-port load inputs acquires the same energy shift. Excess and vacancy Ramsey probes return bright with probability one at π/32, against zero for the matched even-coin contact. This identifies a stored mode invisible to these probes. Electromagnetic neutrality and a finite inertial mass require independent evidence.
